name: com.amaan.utilities
description: A comprehensive suite of Unity utilities, design patterns, helper methods, time and cursor controllers, and gameplay development tools.

samples.description: Sample collectible spawn manager demonstrating strategy-based entity spawning with countdown timers (requires Improved Timers).
Sample scene and scripts demonstrating Unreal Engine Blueprint style flow nodes (DoOnce, DoN, Gate, MultiGate, FlipFlop, Sequence).
Sample enemy and player scripts showing spatial querying and LINQ selector registry.
Sample observable property and observable list implementation.
Sample showing C# using-statement disposable pattern for Unity animations, UI lock, and execution timing.
